fields.acceptance_criteria: The best-next contract documents how graph-aware signals participate in ranking beyond immediate dependees; ticket next and ticket-mcp next_tickets stay deterministic and consistent for equivalent candidate sets; focused regression coverage locks the chosen ranking behavior
fields.title: [ticket-api][ticket-cli][ticket-mcp] Improve next ranking beyond immediate dependees

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. The ranking redesign spec defines a convergence-first contract that can promote eligible prerequisites when more advanced dependents are blocked behind them. 2. ticket next and ticket-mcp next_tickets share one deterministic ordering model that includes transitive reverse impact, dependency-state gap, and explanation metadata instead of immediate dependees alone. 3. The planning explicitly separates the ranking-model work from the HTTP /api/next route while documenting how audit and health consumers reuse the same derived dependency model. 4. Focused regression and follow-up planning cover state-gap promotion, transitive scoring, and convergence findings.
fields.title: [ticket-api][ticket-cli][ticket-mcp] Redesign best-next ranking around dependency convergence

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. Focused regression and follow-up planning cover state-gap promotion, transitive scoring, convergence findings, and cross-surface explainability fields.
